statement: Boundary-tame moduli groupoids obtained from prime-to-p root stacks are invariant under algebraically closed base extension, admit surjective geometric specialization from full characteristic-zero moduli groups, and detect every curve automorphism.
doubtful_reading: No new palaeographic reading. The path groupoid is explicitly boundary tame, not the full etale or maximal prime-to-p moduli groupoid.
notes: Independently reviewed and accepted by root after the exact source check. The proper-DM stack comparison is proved by finite scheme-cover descent; original p-inertia is retained.

statement: A category of all hyperbolic characteristic-p curves with boundary-tame markings and prime-to-p Galois-closure covers has faithful actual-cover inclusion, marking-cover normal forms, compatible cover transport, compact Hom spaces, and base-extension equivalence.
depends_on: BR2007 Prop5.3 Th5.5 Th6.9 Prop6.14 Th6.20 Def6.21-22 Lem6.23 Prop6.24
manuscript_passages: cote 142, (Z.2), requested tame category in E1
doubtful_reading: A repaired construction is stated; literal full-path base invariance remains refuted by E.1.
notes: Retains deck gerbes. Exactness is taken through the cofinal root system; deck injection follows from source-moduli level faithfulness. Arbitrary finite gerbes do not have injective fibre inertia. Root independently verified BR6.23--6.26 and the normalized local branch argument.

statement: After choices of good-reduction type base models, the characteristic-zero category with full markings and only prime-to-p Galois-closure cover arrows specializes to the boundary-tame category, preserving type and cover components and surjecting on automorphism groups and Hom spaces.
doubtful_reading: The source is explicitly the restricted-cover subcategory; the unrestricted functor remains refuted by E.2.
notes: All object/model/path choices and finite-extension compatibility are stated. Hom maps are closed-coset maps with fibres D ker(q) gamma. No faithfulness or automorphism-group injectivity is claimed. Independently reviewed and accepted by root. Literal unrestricted specialization remains refuted.
